Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: full-bleed background for the Russian warm humorous hidden-object space-station game Last Shift.
Primary request: A cozy worn utilitarian space-station kitchen seen FIRST PERSON by someone standing inside it, at natural eye level. Landscape image 1536x1024. Warm handmade watercolor on fibrous rice paper with delicate pencil lines, muted sage green, ochre and indigo, dense natural believable environmental detail and low contrast.
Scene/backdrop: Small lived-in orbital kitchen. Shelves with miscellaneous tins, cups and utensils; hanging ladles, a soft dish towel, cabinet doors, a humble sink and plumbing, subtle worn metal paneling, a rounded window showing quiet stars. Everyday domestic warmth and understated humor in the charming clutter. No people or robots.
Composition/framing: Eye-level perspective from inside the room, looking toward the counter and back wall. Counter stretches across the lower middle of the image; its accessible horizontal work surface is at about 65-68 percent of image height. Leave a small clear counter patch centered at x30% y65% for a later coffee-machine overlay, and another clear patch centered at x68% y66% for a later ration-package overlay. Keep other clutter around these two spots, but leave the spots themselves empty. Objects need to blend into the environment later, so all detail and edges are soft and muted. Camera is not looking down from above.
Lighting/mood: Soft warm practical kitchen light, quiet end-of-shift comfort, inviting and a little weathered. Dense cohesive scene without a dramatic focal object.
Materials/textures: Visible fibrous rice-paper grain throughout, translucent watercolor washes, fine irregular pencil contours, worn painted metal and modest kitchen materials.
Constraints: Full-bleed art all the way to the image edges. No paper margins, no border, no UI, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no visible person, no robot, no coffee machine, no ration package. No cutaway, no dollhouse, no isometric, no top-down view.
